data.summary: Microchip Technology Incorporated (MCHP) intègre l'IA/ML de manière opérationnelle dans ses produits, opérations ou processus selon son 10-K, sans en faire son coeur d'identité.

evidence.quote: There may be increased risk associated with the activities of the acquired company such as regulatory violations related to their use of AI in their operations, technology development or product offerings or cybersecurity or data governance risks.

Demand for AI-related products is subject to concentration and investment-cycle risk, and any slowdown or shift in AI spending could reduce demand for our products, pressure margins, and adversely affect our operating results.
